notes.title: Gunplay, 3C and bugfix new update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, how is this Saturday going? We hope you are all safe and well!
We have just released a small technical update that will modify a few things ingame that could have a certain impact on the gameplay and the game feel of Leap of Champions.

We received feedback from you that certain aspects of the 3C design and implementation (camera, character, control) could have been improved and that's what we worked on.
At the same time, we took the time to rebalance and tweak the gunplay (specifically main and secondary guns) to hopefully make the game feel more rewarding and fair.
We also fixed some bugs in the Forest and Citadel maps and in the Story Mode. We also planned to continue doing so in the next updates as well.
We are also looking into improving and optimising UI and UX of the Story Mode as well as the multiplayer.

As always, please let us know how the gameplay feels now and if we can still do something to make it more fun and engaging. Balancing can be a tricky process, but we have all the will to do so, please just have a little bit of patience until we find the perfect tune for our Champions!
As soon as we found it, we will publish the new figures and data for all the nerds who are interested in them!

We would like to suggest you to keep an eye on our pages, because we have other news coming up!

Thanks for the support, the attention and the patience that you are showing us, they are must appreciated.

Grazie and have a good weekend
LeafGS

notes.title: Leap Of Champion Demo Release
notes.notes:
[h1] A demo version of Leap of Champions is now available[/h1]

[h2]Help us to improve the game 
[/h2]
By downloading the demo, we hope you will be part of our community, to improve the game toghether. So please send us your feedbacks. Soon we'll create a poll with our community, where you can vote new weapons and classes to improve in the new single campaign. 


[h2]About the game 
[/h2]

Leap of Champions is a 3D Competitive and Cooperative First Person Shooter with awesome graphic, and a skill based gameplay. His strongpoints are a fluid gameplay with a solid graphic able to work well on outdated machines as well as on the most powerful ones.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36734178/c78aa133bc2ac831f4c779f4841cd29de381f094.jpg[/img]

[h2]Setting[/h2] 

The game is setting in a futuristic version of our universe and Klepsydria is what we will be calling home. It is the name of the eternal city out of time and space that hides and protect powerful elder artifacts able to control the Flow of Time while the ancient order of Champions, The Order of Klepsydria watch over them.

[h2]What 're you waiting for? Just download it![/h2]

notes.title: Build 1.02 Release on 30-03-2020
notes.notes:
Hi Champions,
on Monday the 30th of March, we will be launching the second content patch (1.02) and Leap of Champions will go from Free to download to Purchasable.
For all the players that already own the game, this new content patch and the following ones will be automatically updated without additional costs.

We are a small indie company that is committed to giving its best in creating more content and a complete gaming experience. For this reason, we are working hard and we believe that the best way to do so is gradually enhancing the game and consequently increasing its price point until the release of the complete game.
We want to thank you for playing Leap of Champions and believing in us, so please keep giving us feedback and reviews so that we can improve the experience around you.


More specifically, in Build 1.02 we worked on:
- [b]Gunplay balancing [/b] optimisation
- [b]New Map: Industrial[/b]
- [b]New Mod: Dominion[/b]
- [b]New Weapon: Machinegun[/b]
- [b]New Steam Achievements[/b]
- General [b]2D improvements[/b]
- Navigability and performance [b]optimisation for the Forest map[/b]
- [b]Bugfix[/b]

Ciao
Leaf Games and Software

notes.title: Release Build 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone and thanks for show your interest for Leap of Champions.
We are currently working really hard to improve the game listening to your reports and suggestions. In this new build we implemented a Score System and a Leaderboard and we hope that you will have a lot of fun challenging the other members of the community! :)
We would love to hear from you, so feel free to share your feedback and suggestions or directly reaching out.

More specifically, in Build 1.01 we worked on:
- [b]Score System[/b] (based on Kills, Victories and in-game achievements)
- [b]Leaderboard[/b]
- [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
- [b]In-game information[/b] about Gameplay (mods, classes, weapons, perks)
- General [b]2D improvements[/b]
- [b]Graphic optimisation[/b] of the map
- Graphic improvement and visual hints for the [b]Bomb’s behaviour[/b]
- [b]Bugfix[/b]

Ciao
Leaf Games and Software
